description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::ProjectImporter class, which contains business logic for importing project data from one project to another. It includes internal and public properties related to project data such as units, articles, recipes, tags, and their relationships, as well as methods for property management, validation, and data import operations.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::ProjectImporter
classes.description: A class implementing business logic for importing project data, managing properties, validation, and data transfer between projects.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Returns a deep clone of the list of public properties.

methods.name: properties_json
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded string of the public properties.

methods.name: importable_properties
methods.description: Returns properties that can be imported into a project based on its inventory.

methods.name: unimportable_properties
methods.description: Returns properties that cannot be imported into a project based on its inventory.

methods.name: _importable_properties
methods.description: Internal method to determine importable or unimportable properties based on inventory and current properties.

methods.name: can_import_properties
methods.description: Checks if a set of properties can be imported into a project, validating their existence and importability.

methods.name: import_data
methods.description: Performs the import of specified properties from a source project to a target project, handling dependencies and ID translations.

methods.name: _validate_properties
methods.description: Validates that the provided property keys are known and their dependencies are satisfied.
